mapper.delete: delete from account_user_applications where user_id = #{userId} and app_code = #{appCode}
mapper.select: select count(*) from account_user_applications ua join account_applications a on a.app_code = ua.app_code join account_users u on u.id = ua.user_id left join account_application_user_states s on s.user_id = ua.user_id and s.app_code = ua.app_code where ua.user_id = #{userId} and ua.app_code = #{appCode} and ua.status = 'enabled' and (a.managed_sync = false or (u.status = 'enabled' and a.status = 'enabled' and ua.desired_status = 'enabled' and s.applied_status = 'enabled' and s.applied_version = ua.version))

select a.app_code, a.name, a.entry_url, a.sso_callback_url, a.permission_iframe_url, a.notify_base_url, a.secret, a.default_tenant_code, a.status, a.secret_version, a.secret_state, a.protocol_capabilities, a.version as application_version, a.managed_sync, a.created_by, a.updated_by, a.created_at, a.updated_at from account_applications a join account_user_applications ua on ua.app_code = a.app_code join account_users u on u.id = ua.user_id left join account_application_user_states s on s.user_id = ua.user_id and s.app_code = ua.app_code where ua.user_id = #{userId} and ua.status = 'enabled' and (a.managed_sync = false or (u.status = 'enabled' and a.status = 'enabled' and ua.desired_status = 'enabled' and s.applied_status = 'enabled' and s.applied_version = ua.version)) order by a.app_code
mapper.sql: select ua.user_id, ua.app_code, ua.desired_status, ua.version, ua.updated_at, coalesce(c.status, 'pending_application_adaptation') as integration_status, c.id as sync_command_id, c.error_code as last_error_code, s.applied_status, s.applied_version, s.last_synced_at from account_user_applications ua left join account_application_user_states s on s.user_id = ua.user_id and s.app_code = ua.app_code left join account_sync_commands c on c.user_id = ua.user_id and c.app_code = ua.app_code and c.sync_version = ua.version and not exists (select 1 from account_sync_commands newer where newer.user_id = c.user_id and newer.app_code = c.app_code and newer.sync_version = c.sync_version and (newer.created_at > c.created_at or (newer.created_at = c.created_at and newer.id > c.id)))
mapper.update: update account_user_applications set status = #{desiredStatus}, desired_status = #{desiredStatus}, version = version + 1, updated_by = #{operatorId}, updated_at = current_timestamp, deauthorized_at = case when #{desiredStatus} = 'disabled' then current_timestamp else null end where user_id = #{userId} and app_code = #{appCode} and version = #{expectedVersion}
